_readme: The exact set of scripts/fixtures/eval/situations.json situation ids the engine (assets/decide.mjs) misses against THIS frozen fixture snapshot, each with a one-line reason: the engine's own pick + the evidence it actually graded it on, versus the key's expected pick + what the key's own rationale leaned on. scripts/test-eval-situations.mjs asserts the LIVE miss set equals this list EXACTLY (a new miss or a newly-passing situation both fail that test) so a real behavior change is always reviewed and this file updated deliberately, never silently absorbed. Root cause common to most of these: the cold key's own rationale field cites 'families' (a: revealed_choice_openrouter, b: human_votes_arena, c: expert_defaults, d: enterprise_evidence) drafted from vendor expert-default rosters and cited enterprise case studies that this engine deliberately does not rank on (only standings.measured/chosen/preferred count) — see assets/decide.mjs's file header. Updated 2026-09-13, round 4: fixed 'cheapest' letting the early/tests-only-vs-T1 start_here block apply to it (it must stay cost-primary, exactly like the existing preview exemption) — this added S02/S09 to the miss set (both genuinely evidenced 'cheapest' picks the key, drafted independently, didn't have visibility into) and did not remove any. must-never 15/15.
